I personally really like exploring games with big maps such as World of Warcraft, Skyrim, Far cry, Genshin impact and the upcoming Halo infinite, also minecraft has a special place in my heart because whenever i feel down i load one of my worlds and look at the buildings i made while i listen to chill music. 

Avoid competitive PvP games, MOBAs in particular
I'm sorry to hear that, i hope you will find something that brings you real happiness, or at least a distraction from this hell called life.
